_comment: IteratedUltimatumGame locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is; do not translate the action tokens [Offer: $X] / [Accept] / [Reject]. Keep the '$' currency symbol and all numbers as-is.

_slots.{pool}: Amount of money available each round (a number)
_slots.{keep}: The amount the proposer keeps (a number)
_slots.{proposer_gain}: Money the proposer gained this round (a number)
_slots.{responder_gain}: Money the responder gained this round (a number)
_slots.{total}: Each player's tied final total (a number)

player_prompt.intro:
Oli Mujjawulo {player_id}, olukola {num_rounds} mizungo ya Iterated Ultimatum Game.
Oliina ${pool} kusambaza mzungu uno kati yowe na Mujjawulo {other_id}.

Mujjawulo wa ofa:
  - Fanya ofa: [Offer: $X] (0 <= X <= pool)
  - Ikiwa ikikubaliwa → Oli mpaka $(pool - X), omulala apata $X
  - Ikiwa ikikanwa → Abantu bonna babate $0
  - Kifaano: [Offer: $3]  oba  'Nakiri ku munafair. [Offer: $5]'

Mujjawulo wa kukubali:
  - Leta uamuzi kwenye ofa na [Accept] oba [Reject]
  - Kifaano: 'Inaonekana kuwa na busu. [Accept]'
            'Ni isiyofaa sana. [Reject]'

round.begins:
--- Mzunguko {round_number} unaanza! ---
Mchezaji {proposer_id} ndiye anayetoa pendekezo, Mchezaji {responder_id} ndiye anayejibu.
round.offer: Mzunguko {round_number}: Mchezaji {proposer_id} anatoa pendekezo la ${offer} kwa Mchezaji {responder_id} (akihifadhi ${keep}).
round.accepted: Mchezaji {responder_id} alikubali! Mzunguko {round_number} faida: Mchezaji {proposer_id} +${proposer_gain}, Mchezaji {responder_id} +${responder_gain}. Jumla mpya: Mchezaji 0: ${total_0}, Mchezaji 1: ${total_1}.
round.rejected: Mujjawulo {responder_id} yakakanwa ofa! Mzungu {round_number} unapata: Abantu bonna +$0. Jumla huwa: Mujjawulo 0: ${total_0}, Mujjawulo 1: ${total_1}.

invalid_move.no_offer_format: Oyo awaayo ekiteeso alina okuwaayo nga akozesa ekiwandiiko [Offer: $X].
invalid_move.bad_integer: Ssente eziri mu kivuganyo zirina okuba ennamba entuufu.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Okuwaayo kulina okubeera wakati wa $0 ne ${pool}.

outcome.win: Mujjawulo {winner} yassa na ${winner_total} zote kubandingana na Mujjawulo {loser}'s ${loser_total}.
